run_alphafold_docker: run the AlphaFold Docker container to predict protein structures from FASTA files with GPU support
create_mount_for_path: create a Docker bind mount mapping a host path to a container target path for data access
run_protein_folding_with_gpu: run protein structure prediction using the AlphaFold Docker image with NVIDIA GPU acceleration enabled
run_alphafold_with_precomputed_msas: run AlphaFold using precomputed MSA files from disk instead of running MSA tools to save time
run_alphafold_benchmark: run AlphaFold in benchmark mode to measure inference timing excluding JAX compilation overhead
